title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: delay loss figures by tier
content:
## Scope

This card belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line and gives, for every tier, the figures held for delay loss: the carrier rolls needed, the two delay loss caps, and the notice period for delay loss.

## Tier card

| Tier | Carrier rolls of the booking needed | Delay loss cap (percent of insured value per container) | Maximum delay loss per container | Notice period for delay loss (calendar days after delivery) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | 0 | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | 0 | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | 0 | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | 0 | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | 0 | 0 percent | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| AHL CargoCare Total | 1 | 10 percent | 25000.00 USD | 21 |

## Definitions

- **Carrier rolls needed**: the number of times the booking must have been rolled by the carrier before delay loss is paid; a figure of 0 is held when delay loss is not covered.
- **Delay loss cap**: the maximum delay loss as a whole percent of the insured value for each container.
- **Maximum delay loss per container**: the maximum delay loss for each container, in US dollars.
- **Notice period for delay loss**: the calendar days after delivery within which notice of delay loss must reach the line.

## Basis Q&A

**Why do five tiers show 0 carrier rolls?** A figure of 0 is held when delay loss is not covered, and only AHL CargoCare Total holds figures for delay loss.

**On AHL CargoCare Total, how many carrier rolls are needed?** At least 1 carrier roll of the booking.
